tool_gate.conclusion: A reproducible full-DP6 standard-cell PPA run against a named library cannot be executed in the current runtime without introducing a synthesis/physical-design toolchain and a named library/PDK or receiving an independently generated frozen-DP6 RTL/netlist.

coefficients.scope: one 256-bit BlaMka G function; not full Argon2 or DP6
coefficients.epistemic_boundary: This is an achieved/synthesized attacker-friendly implementation point, hence an upper bound on resources needed by this primitive in this technology, not a lower bound on future ASIC resources. It excludes memory, BLAKE2 initialization/finalization, RW5, controller/PHY, package and interconnect.

Cell-array-only mathematical lower bound at this published bitcell geometry; actual DP6 SRAM macro requires periphery, redundancy, ECC, routing, banking and interfaces and therefore exceeds this area. Not a universal lower bound across future technologies.

coefficients.coefficient_class: on-die SRAM demonstrated macro density/latency point
coefficients.epistemic_boundary: Demonstrated 2-port macro point, not a strict lower bound for a differently organized single-port DP6 SRAM.
Academic physical/architectural HBM2 energy model. Applying pJ/bit to DP6 logical traffic is attacker-favorable and does not capture all random-access activation/controller/leakage effects.
Projection/model, not measured DP6 silicon and not a procurement-cost point.
Vendor product specification. It proves availability/capability, not achieved DP6 random-I/O throughput, package cost or pJ/bit absolute value.
Vendor average device power per bit and bandwidth are not DP6 achieved random-access metrics and exclude controller/PHY/board effects.

coefficients.coefficient_class: external DRAM PHY area/frequency feasibility point
coefficients.epistemic_boundary: Measured/test-chip point for 16-bit LPDDR4 PHY. Width scaling to GDDR/HBM is not assumed linear.
Published thesis implementation of controller logic; excludes a complete hard mixed-signal PHY/package and is not DP6-specific.

coefficients.reason: Public academic cost models establish dependencies on area, yield, assembly and bonding, but no sufficiently authoritative/current procurement/foundry quote was found that can serve as a conservative lower bound for a DP6 specialized miner.
Public product specifications establish capacity/bandwidth/energy but not a transferable high-volume installed $/GB floor including controller/PHY/package.
No directly comparable published silicon/synthesis implementation of the frozen RW5 machine was found; mapping FPGA resources to ASIC area is explicitly inadmissible.

coefficients.coefficient_class: specialist levelized cost per valid work
coefficients.reason: Cannot close without full/frozen DP6 technology PPA plus memory/package/capex and utilization coefficients.

strongest_plausible_attacker.architecture: external high-bandwidth memory full-state miner with many resident contexts, shared fixed-function Argon/BlaMka engines, microcoded/fixed-function RW5, optional SRAM hot structures/cache, custom memory controller/PHY/interconnect, and low-voltage/frequency optimization
strongest_plausible_attacker.on_die_sram_role: unlikely as the cheapest full 256MiB/context store under published SRAM area evidence; plausible for smaller hot structures/caches

next_frontier.name: Frozen-DP6 Named-Library Standard-Cell PPA Calibration
next_frontier.minimum_request: Provide or authorize one non-production synthesis/PPA environment containing: (a) frozen DP6 RTL/netlist mechanically derived from the already frozen HLS semantics or authority to generate it; (b) one named standard-cell library/PDK with legal access; (c) one synthesis/STA/power flow such as Yosys/OpenROAD-compatible or equivalent; and (d) one named memory PHY/package model. No AWS, FPGA, AFI, F2, consensus, release or deployment authority is required.
